posts.body_html: I just got a division of S. Black from Mike along with HCW Clone F and a few freebies. Thanks Mike! The plant in person looks like a very saturated muddy red/purple color but Jesus... when you take a photo of it being lit from the back, it completely changes its' appearance for the photos. It looks like a shadow even next to a Leucophylla that looks relatively normal for the lighting conditions.
